logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output text/plain --- '[post-transferencias-exp] START - transactionId=' ++ ((vars.transactionId default '') as String) ++ ' | correlationId=' ++ ((correlationId default '') as String)]

logger.doc:name: X-Idempotency-Key present
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output text/plain --- '[post-transferencias-exp] idempotencyKey=' ++ ((vars.idempotencyKey default '') as String)]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import validarSolicitud from modules::validadorSolicitud output application/java --- validarSolicitud( payload, vars.transactionId default "" )

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { id: attributes.headers.'X-Payment-Order-Id', cuentaOrigen: vars.initialPayload.cuentaOrigen, cuentaDestino: vars.initialPayload.cuentaDestino, bancoDestino: vars.initialPayload.bancoDestino, monto: vars.initialPayload.monto, moneda: vars.initialPayload.moneda, concepto: vars.initialPayload.concepto, estado: "APROBADA", fechaSolicitud: vars.initialPayload.fechaSolicitud, fechaProcesamiento: now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssXXX"} }

%dw 2.0 output application/json var statusReason = payload.PaymentInstructions.PaymentInstructionStatus.PaymentInstructionStatus.StatusReason.Text default "INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS" var codigoRechazo = if (statusReason == "INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS") "SALDO_INSUFICIENTE" else "CUENTA_BLOQUEADA" var mensajeRechazo = if (statusReason == "INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS") "La transferencia fue rechazada por saldo insuficiente." else "La transferencia fue rechazada porque la cuenta de destino está bloqueada." --- { codigo: codigoRechazo, mensaje: mensajeRechazo, correlationId: vars.transactionId default "", timestamp: now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssXXX"} }

logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output text/plain --- '[post-transferencias-exp] END - transactionId=' ++ ((vars.transactionId default '') as String) ++ ' | httpStatus=' ++ ((vars.httpStatus default 201) as String)]
